tasks.description:
1. Kill X enemies this run 
2. Earn X cash this run (killing enemies also gives cash. So, this number needs to be high) 
3. Survive X seconds this run 
4. Use Down-Attack X times this run 
5. Use Dash-Attack X times this run 
6. Use Powerslam X times this run (for powerslam, there is a bar that fills up after killing 5 enemies) 
7. Reach X combo hits in Phase 2 
8. Earn X cash in phase 2 
9. Finish Phase 2 without failing once 
10. Instead of asking them to revive, we're going to offer watching an ad to buy a powerslam-ready state. 
Usually they have to kill 5 enemies to get to a state where they can do a powerslam. But you can watch an ad to just start with that state.

tasks.description:
It should have a ticker like the picture that lets the player click on the button at the right time to 4X their bounties earned. 
But that depends on where the ticker landed. And on click it will open an ad (We won't hook the ads yet, just leaving space for it now) 
and the player can easily watch ad to 4X their earning. The ticker will be very slow, not a super hard minigame or anything. 
It'll be slow so that it's easy for the player to 4x the earnings. Right now, we don't have to worry about 4x-in the earnings as bounty 
saving system has not been implemented yet. But we will create this ticker. Something similar and stylish. After ads, it should redirect the 
player to the homepage.
